reset.title: Choose a password
reset.lead: It replaces the old one immediately.

mfa.enrollLead: Required for the owner account. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden…), then enter the code it shows.

contact.title: Let’s talk about your channel

contact.sent: Thank you, your message has been sent. We will reply by email.

profile.title: Your creator profile
profile.lead: This information guides our editors: tone, highlights, platforms.
profile.goalsHint: Example: get people to discover my streams, grow followers on my main channel.
profile.liveAvailabilityHint: Usual frequency and times, for example “3 streams a week, in the evening”.

plan.title: Choose your plan
plan.lead: You can change it at each renewal.

payment.title: Payment by bank transfer
payment.refusedTitle: Your proof of payment was rejected
payment.refusedHelp: Correct the transfer if needed, then upload a new proof below.
payment.referenceHelp: Copy it into the transfer description, otherwise it cannot be matched.
payment.bankMissing: The agency has not entered its bank details yet. Come back a little later or write to us.
payment.delayHint: A transfer can take 1 to 3 business days to arrive. An instant transfer speeds up unlocking.
payment.proofHelp: Screenshot or PDF of the transfer order, showing the amount, date and reference.
payment.dropHint: PNG, JPG, WEBP or PDF · 10 MB maximum
payment.reviewLead: We are checking that the transfer has reached our account. You will be notified by email.
payment.questions: A question about your payment? <link>Contact us</link>.

banners.grace: Your subscription ended on {end}. Grace period until {until}: renew to avoid read-only mode.
banners.readOnly: Your subscription expired on {end}. Your space is read-only: renew to resume uploads and requests.

dashboard.suspended: Your account is currently suspended. Please contact the agency for more information.
dashboard.reviewTitle: Welcome {name}, we are checking your transfer
dashboard.reviewing: Review in progress by the agency

dashboard.title: Dashboard

payments.title: Payment review
payments.companyMissing: Company details (name, legal form, SIRET, address, VAT statement) are incomplete: they must appear on invoices.
payments.bankReminder: Check your bank account before approving. A screenshot does not prove the money has arrived.

review.checkAmount: The amount on the proof matches
review.checkReference: The reference appears in the description
review.checkReceived: The transfer has reached the bank account

messages.amount: The amount received does not match the expected amount. Please top up the transfer using the same reference.
messages.reference: The payment reference does not appear in the transfer description. Please write to us so we can match your transfer.
messages.unreadable: The proof is unreadable. Please upload a clearer screenshot.
messages.notReceived: We have not received your transfer yet. Please check it was sent, then upload a new proof.

review.messageHint: The client will see this message and can upload a new proof.
review.validated: Payment approved: the client’s space is unlocked and the invoice has been issued.
review.refused: Payment rejected: the client has been notified.

plans.title: Plans & pricing
plans.demoWarning: Plans marked “Demo” are examples: replace them with your real plans (or hide them) before welcoming clients.
plans.demoEditHint: Demo plan: saving it turns it into a real plan.

settings.title: Settings
settings.missingCompany: Complete the company details: they appear on invoices and in the legal notice. Nothing is filled in for you.

company.title: Company
company.lead: Mandatory details for invoices and the legal notice.

hints.legal_form: Example: micro-entreprise, EI, SAS with share capital of…
hints.vat_mention: Example for a micro-entreprise: “TVA non applicable, art. 293 B du CGI”. Decide with your accountant.
hints.host: Example: Vercel Inc. and its address, to be checked in Vercel’s terms.

bank.title: Bank details
bank.lead: Shown to clients on the payment page. Every change is recorded in the activity log.

hints.invoice_prefix: Example: F → F-2026-0001 (continuous numbering per year)

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.lead: This address also receives messages from the contact form.

content.title: Site content
content.lead: Website texts and legal pages, in French and English. The “numbers” and “testimonials” sections stay hidden while empty.
content.emptyList: Empty list: the section is not shown.

emails.footer: Peak Clipping Agency — automated email. You can choose which emails you receive in your space.
